Alaska Boats & Permits — Sablefish IFQ Market Prices
_provenance.notes: Sablefish (Anoplopoma fimbria), known commercially as 'black cod', is Alaska's highest-value groundfish by dollar per pound. IFQ (Individual Fishing Quota) programs for sablefish were implemented in 1995 in the Gulf of Alaska (GOA) and Bering Sea / Aleutian Islands (BSAI) under NPFMC Groundfish FMPs. Sablefish IFQ leasebacks typically trade at $18-28/lb, making sablefish permits among the most valuable in Alaska fisheries. The 2024 GOA sablefish TAC was set at 14,790 mt.

ifq_leaseback_market_2024.notes: Sablefish IFQ permits are most valuable in Area D (Southeast Alaska near Sitka/Juneau)
